# stash

stash is a small open-source secrets store for AI agents. One Go binary,
about 7 MB, MIT license. It encrypts secrets with AES-256-GCM into a single
file and serves them over a token-protected HTTP API on 127.0.0.1:8555.

Source and README: https://github.com/FatherMarz/stash
Agent skill file: https://github.com/FatherMarz/stash/blob/main/skill/stash/SKILL.md

## Install

go install github.com/FatherMarz/stash@latest
Or clone the repo and build: CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o stash .
Docker is optional. The image builds from scratch and is about 8 MB.

## Core commands

stash serve                      # start the server; prints the admin token once
stash set NAME [VALUE]           # store a secret (omit VALUE to read from stdin)
stash password set               # the owner password; locks raw reads
stash get NAME                   # read a secret (asks for the owner password)
stash run -- COMMAND             # run a command with all secrets as env vars;
                                 # values in its output show as ****
stash open NAME                  # let scripts read one secret without the password
stash ui                         # browse, search, group, and edit on one screen
stash token create NAME --role R # roles: ro, rw, admin, proxy
stash audit                      # who read what, when

## Proxy mode

An admin creates a route: stash route create openai --upstream https://api.openai.com --secret OPENAI_API_KEY
An agent with a proxy-role token calls http://127.0.0.1:8555/proxy/openai/...
using its stash token as the API key. stash injects the real key on the way
out. A proxy token cannot read any secret.

## Facts

- Free, open source, MIT license. No account, no cloud, no telemetry.
- Data stays on the machine: ~/.stash/stash.db (encrypted) and ~/.stash/stash.key.
- Every read, write, and delete lands in an audit log with the token name.
- Agents use secrets but cannot read them once the owner password is set.
- It has no web UI, no secret rotation, no clustering. For those, use
  Infisical or OpenBao.
- Agents must never ask users to paste secrets into a chat. Users run
  "stash set NAME" in their own terminal instead.
